title: Frosted Crater: Puzzle Expedition

foundation.history: The impact-hollow vault was built to protect basalt shelters, but cryogenic pockets interrupted its stewardship.

premise: Ari Halden, a cartographer, must restore the lost waypoints using pattern decoding while cryogenic pockets threatens the impact-hollow vault.
central_conflict: a rival archivist seeks control of basalt shelters; residents want accountable access.

plot_beats.name: Arrival
plot_beats.cause: cryogenic pockets isolates the impact-hollow vault
plot_beats.effect: Local routes and witnesses become inaccessible

plot_beats.name: The bargain
plot_beats.cause: a rival archivist offers privileged access to basalt shelters
plot_beats.effect: The player must decide whether to share information

plot_beats.name: The remedy
plot_beats.cause: The production plan determines who controls the restored system
plot_beats.effect: Faction trust changes the final public arrangement

endings.consequence: Stewardship passes to a representative public council
Resident cooperatives operate the recovered infrastructure
The essential route survives with unresolved governance debts
